title: trifolium pratense subvar. villosum
intro: Trifolium pratense subvar. villosum, commonly known as red clover, is a perennial legume plant belonging to the family Fabaceae. It has been used for its potential health benefits, including its ability to alleviate menopausal symptoms, such as hot flashes and night sweats, as well as its potential to support cardiovascular health by lowering cholesterol levels and blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of red clover are attributed to its isoflavone content, which can mimic the effects of estrogen in the body, making it a popular alternative for hormone replacement therapy. The bioactive constituents of red clover include isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
